title: Deep Elements: A Mining Puzzle Game about the Periodic Table and Critical Raw Materials
description:
Deep Elements is a free browser game about the periodic table and the supply chains behind everyday technology, for learners aged about 11 and up and for general audiences. Players dig through a mine, dodge cave creatures and falling boulders, and collect the real elements inside devices such as a smartphone, a wind turbine or an MRI scanner. Each element comes with a sourced fact about what it does, where it comes from and how secure its supply is.

The game has 31 missions set at real mines on a world map, each with a quiz question; six guided tutorial lessons; procedurally generated Endless Depths; and three timed Element Runs through the periodic table. It includes a level editor, a teacher's guide with learning objectives, curriculum links and discussion questions, an answer key, and a list of sources for every factual claim.

It runs in any modern browser on computers, tablets and phones, with no installation and no build step. Play online: https://nockemann-lab.github.io/deep-elements/.
